feature: DO i = a TO b FOR n
probe:

feature: DO i = a TO b WHILE cond (controlled loop with a condition)
probe:
DO i = 1 TO 5 WHILE i < 3
SAY i
END
note: RexxJS ignores WHILE, and reads UNTIL into the TO expression (tests/known_differences.json); suggested RexxJS fix.

n = 0

SAY n

n = 0
DO FOREVER
n = n + 1
IF n = 3 THEN LEAVE
END
SAY n

LET a = JSON_PARSE('[1,2]')

SAY v

DO i = 1 TO 3

feature: Label followed by an instruction on the same line
probe:
CALL f
LET r = RESULT
SAY r
EXIT
f: RETURN 9
note: Classic Rexx allows an instruction after a label on its line. RexxAE rejects it (label must occupy its own clause); RexxJS gives RESULT null.

feature: Internal function call of a label: f(x)
probe:
LET r = sq(3)
SAY r
EXIT
sq:
ARG n
LET v = n * n
RETURN v
note: Classic Rexx calls an internal routine as a function. Neither engine does: RexxAE reports an unknown function; RexxJS sends the clause to the default ADDRESS environment.

probe:
x = 1
y = 2
CALL f
SAY x y
EXIT
f: PROCEDURE EXPOSE x
x = 10
y = 20
RETURN

CALL f 'a'
EXIT
f:
ARG v
SAY v
RETURN
note: Classic ARG uppercases (it is PARSE UPPER ARG); both engines keep the case.
RexxJS runs the label's clauses and then the skipped clauses too (here, skipped); suggested RexxJS fix.

feature: SAY delivers a line to the host
LINEIN / LINEOUT / CHARIN / CHAROUT / LINES / CHARS / STREAM

feature: Application functions mounted by the host
reason: rexxae_register_function: a script calls named host functions with typed JSON arguments; the host answers each request.

feature: No file, network or OS effects without a host grant
reason: The library build has no fs/net/os capability; tools/check_containment.py and make containment hold it.

feature: Host requests: COMMAND, FUNCTION, LOG events and suspension
reason: aether_rexxae_step returns a request and the engine suspends until the host replies; no callbacks into the host.

feature: EXPORT('label') and rexxae_call: the host calls a script's labels
reason: The worker serves exported labels over std.guest INVOKE; rexxae_call runs a label of a finished program.
The one thread-safe entry point; the script cannot catch it.
aether_rexxae_step(ctx, budget) returns RUNNABLE when the budget is spent.
A separate contained process for scripts; see README "Worker process".
RexxAE extensions (docs/cron-and-logging.md); in RexxJS LOG is the logarithm.

feature: REQUIRE of npm and JavaScript libraries (RexxJS)
reason: Loads JavaScript modules into the interpreter; RexxAE's REQUIRE goes to a host resolver and loads Rexx only.
Runs JavaScript; RexxAE has no JavaScript runtime by design.
Progress callbacks to a browser parent window.
